messages:
elena: hi team — redeemed promo via web UI a few minutes ago, got the confirmation modal saying it applied, but my org balance didn't change. org_id: org_23q7, code: SPRINGBOOST2026. Can someone check?

maya: @elena can you paste the redemption id from the confirmation email or the webhook id? also which env (prod/us-west)? :eyes:

elena: redemption id in email = rd_8a7c1f, region = prod (us-west1). UI showed green check and message 'Promo applied'. no new usage or credits in console.

maya: thanks — grabbing ledger entries now. attaching what I see in the webhook ingestion logs.

maya: ```
2026-03-17T14:22:12Z INFO webhook=promo/redemptions id=rd_8a7c1f status=accepted payload={amount:null, currency:"USD", code:"SPRINGBOOST2026"}
2026-03-17T14:22:13Z ERROR ledger.ingest job=ingest-472 failure=ValidationError: amount missing
```

kevin: looks like the webhook payload had amount:null — upstream service accepted the code but didn't attach the numeric value. ledger ingestion rejects null amount so no credit applied.

elena: is that a customer or prod bug? they got the email that it worked, that's confusing for users.

kevin: root cause likely in promo service when creating grants for legacy trial codes — sometimes amount is omitted for percentage-based promo types. For this code I don't see a percent field either. I'm going to re-run a safe ingest with fallback amount from the promo catalog.

jen: tagging eng — @jen here, I can push a one-off fix. Before I do, can we confirm the intended credit amount? kevin, can you confirm catalog amount for SPRINGBOOST2026?

kevin: catalog lookup: SPRINGBOOST2026 => 15000 (i.e., $150 in cents). I'll provide the internal grant payload.

jen: cool. plan: 1) manual ledger patch to apply rd_8a7c1f as a grant of 15000 cents to org_23q7 (will record as admin-grant), 2) a follow-up fix to the webhook ingestion to tolerate null amounts by rejecting at promo-service and preventing the misleading confirmation email, 3) short postmortem.

maya: elena — we will apply the credits now and follow up once done. do you want us to confirm when you see the balance update in console?

elena: yes please, ping me when done. thanks.

ledger-bot: ACTION_STARTED apply_grant id=patch-gn-20260317 target_org=org_23q7 amount=15000 source=manual_admin ts=2026-03-17T14:45:01Z

ledger-bot: ACTION_SUCCEEDED apply_grant id=patch-gn-20260317 target_org=org_23q7 new_balance=175000 ts=2026-03-17T14:45:03Z

maya: I see the ledger patch succeeded and balance now shows +15000. elena can you confirm the console reflects the change?

elena: I can see the credits now, balance updated. thanks everyone :tada:

kevin: follow-up — created ticket INF-6521 to add server-side validation in promo-service to block null amounts and to stop sending success emails when required fields are missing. also added an ingestion tolerance flag so future safe-fallbacks are explicit.

jen: I'll take the postmortem, short write-up and remediation steps by EOD. tagging #eng-runtime for visibility.

elena: appreciate the fast turnaround!

maya: closing this thread once postmortem link is posted. :white_check_mark:
